text:
mira: Heads up — regen diff for the sample-app landed and the release gate blocked the publish. CI says a semver bump is possible but I didn't change any public types, just regenerated. Anyone seen parameter-order-ish diffs cause semver flags?
eli: can you paste the diff or a snippet?
mira: here's the relevant part of the typegen diff: ```diff
- func CreateUser(ctx context.Context, name string, opts CreateUserOptions)
+ func CreateUser(ctx context.Context, opts CreateUserOptions, name string)
```
gaben: that looks like optional param reordering from the generator. we've seen this when sorting is non-deterministic. sometimes locale/author metadata changes ordering.
regen-bot: regen-report: file: src/api/users.gen.go, changes: 1, potential-semver-change: parameter-order. action: release-gate: BLOCKED
carla: can you paste the CI log where the gate failed?
mira: ```
RUNNING typegen-check
Error: regen diff non-empty
Exit code: 3
release-gate: blocked: semver risk detected
```
eli: unrelated note — the go sdk had a flaky auth/retry parity test last week; might be a separate token ordering flake but worth flagging.
gaben: probable root: our deterministic-sort patch didn't apply to some older generated files. in those cases sorting falls back to map iteration order. if the commit author or locale is absent we see nondet ordering.
mira: ugh. how do we fix quickly? re-run typegen with stable-sort? change generator to stable-key?
carla: short-term: run `make typegen-stable` in repo and commit regenerated files (should match). longer: i'll open a typegen patch to enforce sort by (path, operationId, parameterName) fallback.
eli: also update changelog heuristics: the changelog generator treats param-reorder as a breaking change unless we flag it as reorder-only; that caused the semver bump.
mira: i'll try local regen and push. pinging @devex for visibility.
mira: running: `make typegen-stable && git add -A && git commit -m "regen: stable sort to avoid nondet param order" && git push`
mira: quick output: ```
INFO: running stable sort
INFO: regen complete
INFO: diff empty
```
regen-bot: re-run report: files changed: 0, potential-semver-change: 0, release-gate: PASS
gaben: great. assigning: carla -> typegen deterministic sort PR, mira -> sample-app regen commit. target: patch today or hold publish.
carla: creating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/482 — adds deterministic key and unit test for locale variations. PTAL.
mira: CI for sample-app passed, release gate green. marking this thread resolved.
carla: follow-up: i'll add an upstream test that simulates missing author/locale to catch this in CI.
regen-bot: note: auto-notice will add changelog entry only if user-facing signature changed; param reorder-only now annotated as non-semver by heuristics in next release.
mira: thanks all — closing thread.
